description: Winter Storm Uri collapsed the ERCOT grid and gas system, freezing Gulf Coast petrochemical plants; PVC, epichlorohydrin and ethylene glycol producers declared force majeure with ~100% of epichlorohydrin offline.
Hurricane Katrina made landfall as a Category 3 storm, flooding the Chalmette refinery and shutting a large share of US Gulf refining, offshore production and chemical feedstock supply.

Typhoon In-fa remnants dumped a year's rain on Henan province in three days, flooding Zhengzhou and Xinxiang and halting industrial output, coal logistics and power infrastructure across the province.
An LPG leak triggered a fire and explosion at the ARO-3 aromatics unit of the Mailiao petrochemical complex, forcing evacuation of 10,000 residents and an 18-month unit shutdown.
An explosion while cleaning hydrogen-purification heat-exchanger equipment killed five workers and suspended production at the Yokkaichi polysilicon plant, a semiconductor-grade silicon source.
An explosion during restart of the No.2 alkylation unit at the Onsan refinery killed one and injured nine, shutting the alkylation, No.2 RFCC and No.2 paraxylene units.
Gazprom progressively cut and then halted Nord Stream 1 deliveries to Europe citing turbine maintenance, removing the single largest source of European industrial gas supply.
Russian pipeline gas cuts drove European gas prices to records, forcing BASF to curtail ammonia production at Ludwigshafen and prompting Europe-wide chemical output reductions.
China informally halted rare earth exports to Japan amid the Senkaku/Diaoyu trawler dispute, exposing Japanese magnet, motor and electronics chains to a single-source chokepoint.
Indonesia banned all nickel ore exports two years ahead of schedule to force domestic downstream processing, cutting off the largest global source of nickel ore feedstock.
